About Bay St. Louis

Living in Bay St. Louis

Bay St. Louis is the seat of Hancock County, on the west side of the Bay of St. Louis. Old Town, its walkable downtown on a bluff above the beach, is known for galleries, restaurants and a monthly art walk.

Homes range from cottages in Old Town to larger lots and newer houses out toward Interstate 10. NASA's Stennis Space Center is in Hancock County, north of town.

Places to know

Around Bay St. Louis

  • Old Town Bay St. LouisShops, galleries and restaurants above the beach, with a Second Saturday art walk.
  • Bay St. Louis Municipal HarborMarina and boardwalk at the foot of Old Town.
  • Historic L&N train depotRestored depot that houses the Alice Moseley Folk Art and Antique Museum and a Mardi Gras museum.
  • Stennis Space CenterNASA's rocket engine test center, with the INFINITY Science Center visitor center at I-10.
  • Bay St. Louis BridgeUS 90 bridge to Pass Christian with a walking path.

Getting around

Roads and commute

US 90 crosses the Bay St. Louis Bridge east to Harrison County and runs west to Waveland. Interstate 10 is north of town, and New Orleans is about an hour west.

Near the water

Flood zones and insurance costs can change from one street to the next on the Coast. Look up any address on FEMA's flood map, and ask me for help getting insurance quotes before you make an offer.
